name: a receipt read at its own instant verifies the purchase; a purchase whose receipt was never read is never NOT_FOUND
notes: §3 v1.9: a gmail.receipt pass that parsed an opened receipt covers only that message's instant (windowStart = windowEnd). Two such passes, both acct-a (one account, so no account cap; the grant binds none): the Stripe receipt sent 14:03, opened and parsed at 14:10; and another receipt sent 09:15, opened at 14:50. receiptMerchants is patched to ['stripe', 'amazon'], so no claim below is capped by coverage.no_parser: the points alone decide.

c1 'Stripe' 4999 USD at 14:02 (minute): unit [14:02, 14:03], window [14:00, 14:48]. o1 merchant 'Stripe' 4999 USD at 14:03 lies in the window. Applicable: timeProximity 2500, amountExact 2500, merchantMatch 2000 (no subject); Σw = 7000. tp 1 (Δ = 0, inside the unit); amountExact 1 (4999 USD both); merchantMatch 1 (name 'stripe' = 'stripe') → S = 7000/7000 = 1/1 ≥ 8500 bp → assigned.

c1 coverage (§6.1): the 14:03 point overlaps the window but a point never contains a window of positive length → partial, so no_coverage does not fire and verified does: VERIFIED. FINAL (§8): a gmail.receipt entry synced 14:50 ≥ end + graceMin = 14:33. Before the 14:50 pass the only receipt sync was 14:10 < 14:33: VERIFIED but PENDING, until the next receipt the user opens.

c2 'Amazon' 2000 USD at 14:02: window [14:00, 14:48]. o1 is assigned to c1 and leaves c2's candidates (§4.3) → match.none, score null. Coverage: the 14:03 point overlaps → partial (the 09:15 point is outside). graceElapsed: 14:50 ≥ end + 30 = 14:33 and ≥ end + 45 = 14:48 → pending does not fire. partial_coverage (coverage partial, bestScoreLt partial: no candidate) → UNVERIFIABLE, reasons coverage.partial {source: gmail.receipt}, match.none. PENDING: 15:00 < end + 24 h. Never NOT_FOUND: Attest read one message in that window, not the inbox (Hard Rule 5).
No activity → no orphan receipt; o1 is assigned anyway.
